instruction.text: Match the sentences to their meanings.

atoms.b: The nurse works shifts that last 12 hours each.
The nurse works 12 shifts, each of which last an hour.

instruction.text: Match the sentences to their meanings.

atoms.b: The girls who are thirty-one years old
The thirty girls who are each one-year old.

instruction.text: Match the sentences to their meanings.

atoms.b: The documents which are each ten pages long.

instruction.text: Choose the correct way to write these words with hyphens in the correct place.

atoms.a: Twentieth-century football was practically a different sport to the modern game.
atoms.b: ((++Twentieth-century Twentieth_century)) football was practically a different sport to the modern game.

atoms.a: Moe won the hundred-metre sprint by a distance.
atoms.b: Moe won the ((hundred_metre ++hundred-metre)) sprint by a distance.

feedback.wrong: If the number comes second in the compound adjective, a hyphen is not used.

instruction.text: Choose all the words in the sentence that need a hyphen between them.

atoms.a: I work at a nursery where I have to look after twenty two year olds.
atoms.b: I work at a nursery where I have to look after twenty ((two year olds)).

instruction.text: Now write the word with the hyphen in the correct place.

atoms.b: I work at a nursery where I have to look after twenty ((two-year-olds)).

instruction.text: Choose all the words in the sentence that need a hyphen between them.

atoms.a: I half wanted to tip the half full bucket of ice on my sister but decided against it.
atoms.b: I ((half wanted)) to tip the ((half full)) bucket of ice on my sister but decided against it.

instruction.text: Now write the word with the hyphen in the correct place.

atoms.b: I ((half-wanted)) to tip the ((half-full)) bucket of ice on my sister but decided against it.
